summary: St. Joe NF site: 1922 10-foot pole tower with cupola, 1925 log cabin, 1931 20-foot L-4 tower; the tower was destroyed in 1969 and footings, a beam and debris were reported in 2024.

facts.design: 1922 10-foot pole tower with a metal cupola; 1925 log cabin a quarter mile south; 1931 20-foot pole L-4 tower
facts.status_note: The 1931 tower was destroyed in 1969. A post dated October 29, 2024 reports cement footings, one support beam, a root cellar and debris at the site; the team believes the footings and beam came from the 1931 tower.

access.note: Listed as hike-in on St. Joe National Forest land. None of the three sources mentions a closure or a permit.

visit.trail_note: Tagged Hike-In by the Idaho Fire Lookouts page. Reported remains are cement footings, one support beam, a root cellar and debris; there is no tower to climb.

notes_for_editor: The three sources agree on the 1922, 1925 and 1931 structures and the 1969 destruction. The footings and beam are the Idaho Fire Lookouts team's belief ('what we believe'), so the story presents them that way. Elevation 6531 ft appears on firelookout.com and the Idaho Fire Lookouts page; the schema has no elevation key. A USFS Idaho Panhandle NF Facebook post appeared only as a search snippet (not read) and is not used. Route and closure details were not found, so access rests on the Hike-In tag and the St. Joe National Forest listing. The brief's kind 'tower' fits the sources.
